headlines.description: Jordan Todman juked one defender and stiff-armed another on his way to a 62-yard touchdown run that helped the Jacksonville Jaguars beat the Tennessee Titans 21-13 on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jags handle Titans in showdown of AFC dregs

headlines.description: The Philadelphia Eagles are on the brink of elimination from the playoff race after a 27-24 loss to the Washington Redskins on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Eagles' playoff chances hurt as Redskins win

events.name: San Diego Chargers at San Francisco 49ers

headlines.description: Nick Novak kicked a 40-yard field goal nearly 5 minutes into overtime after Philip Rivers rallied San Diego back from a 21-point deficit in the second half, keeping the Chargers' slim playoff hopes alive with a 38-35 victory over the San Francisco 49ers.

Joique Bell scored the go-ahead touchdown on a sweet run in the fourth quarter, Ndamukong Suh had two sacks and the playoff-bound Detroit Lions beat Jimmy Clausen and the Chicago Bears 20-14 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Stafford, Suh lead Lions over Bears 20-14

headlines.description: Late safety helps Dolphins rally past Vikings 37-35
headlines.shortLinkText: Late safety helps Dolphins rally past Vikings 37-35

events.name: Atlanta Falcons at New Orleans Saints

headlines.description: Julio Jones returned from a hip injury to catch seven passes for 107 yards, and the Atlanta Falcons remained in playoff contention with a 30-14 victory over New Orleans on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Falcons eliminate Saints, stay in South hunt

events.name: New England Patriots at New York Jets

headlines.description: Jonas Gray scored the go-ahead touchdown on a 1-yard run early in the fourth quarter after the Patriots intercepted Geno Smith, and New England clinched a first-round playoff bye with a 17-16 victory over the New York Jets on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Patriots escape Jets to pick up 1st-round bye

events.name: Kansas City Chiefs at Pittsburgh Steelers

headlines.description: Ben Roethlisberger passed for 220 yards and a touchdown, Le'Veon Bell added a score and the Pittsburgh Steelers locked up a postseason berth with a methodical 20-12 win over the Kansas City Chiefs on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Steelers stop Chiefs to end playoff drought

events.name: Green Bay Packers at Tampa Bay Buccaneers

headlines.description: Aaron Rodgers threw for 318 yards and one touchdown Sunday to help the Green Bay Packers beat the Tampa Bay Buccaneers 20-3 and clinch a wild-card playoff berth on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rodgers, Pack rebound to clinch playoff spot

headlines.description: Cam Newton threw for one touchdown and ran for another, and the Carolina Panthers defeated the Cleveland Browns 17-13 on Sunday to take over sole possession of first place in the NFC South.
headlines.shortLinkText: Panthers beat Browns, move into 1st place

headlines.description: Foster, defense lead Texans over Ravens 25-13
headlines.shortLinkText: Foster, defense lead Texans over Ravens 25-13

events.name: New York Giants at St. Louis Rams

headlines.description: Rookie Beckham leads Giants past Rams 37-27
headlines.shortLinkText: Rookie Beckham leads Giants past Rams 37-27

headlines.description: Dallas ended a four-year playoff drought Sunday in a dominating 42-7 victory over the Colts, with Tony Romo throwing four touchdown passes and breaking Troy Aikman's franchise record for yards passing.
headlines.shortLinkText: Romo-led Cowboys smack Colts, win NFC East

headlines.description: Derek Carr threw two touchdown passes and Sebastian Janikowski kicked four field goals to help the Oakland Raiders knock the Buffalo Bills from playoff contention with a 26-24 victory Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Raiders knock out Bills with 26-24 win

headlines.description: The Seattle Seahawks and Arizona Cardinals were scoreless in a defensive-dominated first quarter in their NFC West showdown Sunday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Seahawks rout Cards behind big-play offense

headlines.description: Dre Kirkpatrick returned Peyton Manning's third interception for a touchdown in the closing minutes on Monday night, completing a fourth-quarter rally that gave the Bengals a 37-28 victory and a spot in the playoffs.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bengals' late pick-6 of Peyton helps seal berth
